claim: Raw engrossed parchment vs 1823 Stone engraving · material + paleographic symbology that the engraving pass flattens or drops
epistemic: Educational paleography · not conspiracy · National Treasure references labeled fiction · verify NARA for critical claims
doctrine: Raw = animal parchment + iron-gall ink as imaged by NARA (Charters of Freedom)
Stone = 1823 copperplate engraving by William J. Stone — a legibility facsimile, not the object
Missing symbology on Stone is mostly material: texture, ink relief, fade patterns, signature ductus, surface scars
Movie lore is optional flavor · never replaces primary source analysis

raw.label: Raw engrossed parchment (NARA)
raw.whatItIs: Scan of the actual Matlack engrossed sheet on animal parchment

stone.label: Stone engraving 1823 (NARA)
stone.credit: National Archives · public domain · William J. Stone
stone.whatItIs: High-res scan of the engraved facsimile plate — sharper type, less material truth

whyCompare: Stone is excellent for reading and ink-cut geometry, but it is a second-generation mark. Raw holds the three-dimensional iron-gall symbology, damage history, and hand pressure that any serious (or cinematic) analysis needs before you get to Nicolas Cage.

nationalTreasure.label: National Treasure (2004) · fun lane
fact: The engrossed Declaration is a real NARA object (Rotunda, Charters of Freedom).
Iron-gall ink fades; the original is far less legible than the Stone engraving.
Historical interest in invisible ink and ciphers in the Revolutionary era is real — the film invents the specific map-on-the-back plot.
fiction: Treasure map on the reverse of the Declaration as depicted in the film.
Ottendorf cipher / Silence Dogood trail as a single treasure hunt scripted for the movie.
Reading the document under lemon juice / heat as the primary scholarly method (do not try this on real artifacts).
nationalTreasure.analysisHook: If the Stone pass is all you analyze, you lose the raw surface symbology the movie pretends to chase — and you will not make it to dojo-grade, let alone Cage-grade.
nationalTreasure.dojoNote: Dojo / research should always pair raw + Stone: one for material marks, one for high-contrast reading.
